_comment: Producer-minted policy.resolve contract vectors. Each vector's request is executed against the live dispatch in policy_ops tests and the reply/error asserted byte-equal, so these bytes ARE the wire contract. Consumers (subc-client-rs policy_cache) vendor this file under the digest-pin discipline. Subject placeholders: {AGENT_ID} is substituted with the seeded agent's id at test time; every other byte is literal. Reply revision is the CURRENT global policy generation at resolve time (the cache watermark), never the matched rule's write-time stamp - all vectors resolve against a store whose generation is 3. Project reference is an untagged two-form like subject: {project_root} | {project_id} (plexus subscriptions carry ids, not roots); an unknown project_id REFUSES project_unresolved rather than draping the closed default over a typo. Complete verdict vocabulary: rules carry allow | deny | ask (closed at authoring per domain); replies additionally serve deny (policy-less approval default) and deny_unknown_domain (undeclared domain marker). ask is the attended-parking verdict: consumers park attended callers and treat unattended refusal-to-proceed as transient-fault per the cascade spec.

push_event._comment: The policy.subscribe held-stream event, byte-pinned from the producer's encoder. Shape is NESTED {op, body:{revision}} - the held-stream emit framing shared with rooms.hint_wait, not a flat {revision}. HOLD SEMANTICS: one event per hold, by construction (oneshot waiters, same park-and-rehold shape as rooms.hint_wait); a consumer re-subscribes after each event, and a bump between holds is absorbed by the TTL refetch - hint-only per constraint 4.
